svg.text: MODERNBERT-LARGE'S 28 LAYERS: EVERY THIRD ATTENDS GLOBALLY; THE REST SEE 64 POSITIONS EITHER SIDE
G: global, 10 layers, RoPE θ = 160,000 · L: local window, 18 layers, RoPE θ = 10,000
Computed from the checkpoint's layer_types and local_attention = 128, with transformers 5.17's rule |i − j| ≤ local_attention / 2. Route row, 141 positions.
